news.title: Saint Louis University Launches Direct Admission for 1818 Advanced College Credit Students
news.summary_en: SLU is launching a new direct admission program that allows eligible 1818 students to be admitted to the University without completing a separate application, submitting an essay or test scores, or providing a Secondary School Report.

news.title: SLU Research Finds Pandemic-Era Drop in Social Participation Associated With Cognitive Decline in Older Adults
news.summary_en: In new research findings, SLU researchers found that older adults who stopped participating in community activities during the pandemic showed poorer cognitive functioning in 2022 than those who remained engaged.
